title: Outright Residuary Estate
text: {% if outright_will.residuary.disposition == "named" %}I give the residue of my estate to {{ outright_will.residuary.named.full_name | name }}, if that person survives me. If that person does not survive me, I give the residue of my estate to {{ outright_will.residuary.alternate.full_name | name }}, if that person survives me. If neither {{ outright_will.residuary.named.full_name | name }} nor {{ outright_will.residuary.alternate.full_name | name }} survives me, I give the residue of my estate to my heirs at law under the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts as then in effect.{% elif outright_will.residuary.disposition == "spouse_then_descendants" and has_spouse %}I give the residue of my estate to my spouse, {{ spouse.full_name | name }}, if my spouse survives me. If my spouse does not survive me, I give the residue of my estate to my descendants, per stirpes. If no descendant of mine survives me, I give the residue of my estate to my heirs at law under the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts as then in effect.{% else %}I give the residue of my estate to my descendants, per stirpes. If no descendant of mine survives me, I give the residue of my estate to my heirs at law under the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts as then in effect.{% endif %}
